title: Ordinary etale compact-support scalar compatibility with projection and composition
statement:
Let $A\to A'$ be a unital homomorphism of finite commutative rings, and let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type morphism between Noetherian schemes, each admitting a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Choose a compactification $f=pj$, with $j:X\hookrightarrow\overline X$ open and $p:\overline X\to Y$ proper [def-asd-compactifiable]. Work in the ordinary unbounded derived categories of constant-ring module sheaves on the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with $Q_T=(-)\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}A'$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Use the canonical K-flat tensor/pullback identifications [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback] and the usual tensor unit $Q_T(A_T[0])\cong A'_T[0]$ induced by multiplication.

Put $F_{f,R}=Rf_{!,R}=Rp_{*,R}j_{!,R}$ for $R=A,A'$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support]. Define $q_f:Q_YF_{f,A}\to F_{f,A'}Q_X$ by the proper scalar map of [lem-asd-proper-finite-coefficient-extension] evaluated at $j_{!,A}(-)$, followed by $Rp_{*,A'}$ of the open scalar tensor map $Q_{\overline X}j_{!,A}\cong j_{!,A'}Q_X$. The latter is the canonical balancing map: on the open it is scalar tensor, and off the open it is the zero-module map; its inverse is the open-adjunction transpose of the scalar extension of the open unit. Let $P_{f,R;K,M}:K\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}F_{f,R}M\to F_{f,R}(f^*K\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}M)$ be the proper-counit/open-tensor projection transformation [lem-amb-proper-coproducts-projection, lem-pur-etale-open-derived-tensor].

Then $q_f$ is a natural isomorphism on the entire derived category. For every $K\in D(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $M\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ the specified morphisms satisfy
$$q_{f,f^*K\otimes M}\circ Q_Y(P_{f,A;K,M})=P_{f,A';Q_YK,Q_XM}\circ(1\otimes q_{f,M}),$$
after the canonical scalar tensor and scalar/pullback identifications of source and target. For composable compactifiable separated finite-type morphisms $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow g Z$ between Noetherian schemes, use the proper/open triangle-normalized compact-support composition $\alpha_R:F_{g,R}F_{f,R}\cong F_{gf,R}$ [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons]. If $M\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $Q_XM\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},A')$, then
$$q_{gf,M}\circ Q_Z(\alpha_{A,M})=\alpha_{A',Q_XM}\circ F_{g,A'}(q_{f,M})\circ q_{g,F_{f,A}M}.$$
For an open immersion $v:V\hookrightarrow Y$, put $X_V=f^{-1}(V)$, $f_V:X_V\to V$, $v_X:X_V\hookrightarrow X$, and give $f_V$ the restricted compactification $X_V\hookrightarrow p^{-1}(V)\to V$. Then, for every $M\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, the specified maps satisfy $$C_{f,v,A'}(Q_XM)\circ v^*(q_{f,M})=q_{f_V,v_X^*M}\circ Q_V(C_{f,v,A}(M)),$$ where $C_{f,v,R}:v^*F_{f,R}\cong F_{f_V,R}v_X^*$ is the compact-support exchange of [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons], and the source $v^*Q_YF_{f,A}M$ is identified with $Q_Vv^*F_{f,A}M$ and $v_X^*Q_XM$ with $Q_{X_V}v_X^*M$ by the canonical scalar/pullback identifications. These comparisons respect proper refinements of compactifications on these bounded-below inputs and the canonical coefficient-unit identification. No flatness or finite projective dimension of $A'$ over $A$, smoothness of $f$, orientation, or exceptional-pullback coefficient comparison is assumed.

The scalar tensor and unit identifications are the normalized maps of [def-pur-exceptional-coefficient-normalizations], and the compact-support coefficient comparison is the map of [def-per-exceptional-coefficient-maps]; these are the same proper/open arrows just specified.

proof.text: Write $B=A'$. Use the cited monoidal comparisons for all scalar/pullback identifications. The open balancing isomorphism restricts to identity; its inverse therefore has the prescribed open-unit transpose. Thus $q_f=Rp_{*,B}\beta_j\circ\chi_pj_{!,A}$ is a natural isomorphism. The proper comparison applies: $\overline X$ is Noetherian by finite type over $Y$; restricted ambients are Noetherian opens.

Apply exchange/tensor coherence to the identity-topos coefficient square for $p$. Its counit mate is $\chi_p$; tensor symmetries give the ordered proper projection square. The mixed open scalar/tensor square gives its open counterpart; its fixed $q_\varphi$ is $\beta_j$, since $\beta_j$ is normalized degreewise on K-flat models and so satisfies the open normalization predicate whose unique solution is $q_\varphi$; likewise its $r_\varphi$ is the exact-pullback identification $\lambda^{\mathrm{ex}}_j$, and its $\gamma$ is the inverse of the open tensor map. Substitute $P_f=Rp_*O_j\circ P_p$ and the formula for $q_f$; naturality moves $\chi_p$ past $Q(O_j)$. The two squares yield exactly the stated projection equation.

proof.text: For a proper refinement $u$ apply its coefficient square to $M, Q_XM\in D^+$. Apply the outer proper direct image and use scalar/direct-image composition; this gives the refinement square for $q_f$. The comparison cocycle extends it through common refinements.

Use the comparison theorem's tower $i,s,p,b,q,j$ with $bj=a$ (write $r=q$). On $E=j_!M$, paste the proper/open coefficient-mate square with the outer $Rs_*$ and inner $j_!$ scalar maps. The two constituent composition identities turn its boundaries into the claimed $q_{gf}Q\alpha$ and $\alpha F_g(q_f)q_g$. Step 3 transfers compactification choices.

The bounds in Step 4 hold: exact $j_!$ makes $E$ and $QE\cong j_!QM$ bounded below. A bounded-below injective representative computes $Rr_*$, so $F_fM,F_fQM\in D^+$. Step 1 identifies $QF_fM\cong F_fQM$, supplying the outer refinement's second bound. All tower ambients are Noetherian by finite type and open restriction.

Write $C_{f,v}=Rp_{V,*}(e_j)\circ\operatorname{Ex}_p(j_!(-))$. Substitute this and $q_f$ into the open-restriction equation. Naturality moves the open scalar factor across proper exchange; the two cited scalar/exchange squares then give precisely $q_{f_V}Q(C_{f,v})$, with the specified scalar/pullback identifications.

The monoidal unit is multiplication $a\otimes b\mapsto\varphi(a)b$. Its tensor and pullback unit equations are the cited monoidal coherence. Open balancing is identity on the open, while proper projection at the unit is identity. Substituting these unit identities in the preceding pasted squares proves the coefficient-unit compatibility.

lean.statement: theorem etaleCompactScalarCoherence [Finite A] [Finite B] (φ : A →+* B) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y] (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] (c : Compactification f) : (∀ M : DerivedCategoryModule A X, IsIso ((compactScalarMap φ c).app M)) ∧ (∀ (K : DerivedCategoryModule A Y) (M : DerivedCategoryModule A X), (scalarExtension φ Y).map (compactScalarProjection A c K M) ≫ (compactScalarMap φ c).app (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).leftDerivedFunctor.obj K)).obj M) ≫ (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) c).map (compactScalarProjectionTarget φ f K M) = (ExceptionalCoefficients.tensorIso φ Y).hom.app (K, (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c).obj M) ≫ ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) Y).obj ((scalarExtension φ Y).obj K)).map ((compactScalarMap φ c).app M) ≫ compactScalarProjection B c ((scalarExtension φ Y).obj K) ((scalarExtension φ X).obj M)) ∧ (∀ (d : Compactification f) (M : _root_.DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))), (∃ N : _root_.DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)), N.obj = (scalarExtension φ X).obj M.obj) → (scalarExtension φ Y).map ((rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationIso A c d).hom.app M.obj) ≫ (compactScalarMap φ d).app M.obj = (compactScalarMap φ c).app M.obj ≫ (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationIso B c d).hom.app ((scalarExtension φ X).obj M.obj))
